experience.title: Senior Vice President, CIO – Shared Services and Infrastructure
bullets: Owned the shared technology foundations and operational services supporting USAA's P&C, banking, life, investment, retirement, and enterprise functions, including core infrastructure, engineering platforms, corporate systems, the IT PMO, vendor management, and the technology operating model. Led 1,200 employees and 2,000 partners with direct accountability for a $1.2B budget.

Translated line-of-business priorities, including claims operations, underwriting economics, payment processing and settlement, Medicare annual enrollment demand, regulatory obligations, and customer servicing, into investment, capacity, resilience, recovery, and modernization priorities.

Reduced the directly managed departmental budget by $415M, from $1.2B to $785M, through automation-enabled employee and partner reductions, hardware and software renegotiation, modernization, and consolidation. This included a portion of the $294M enterprise-wide third-party labor takeout, which exceeded the $265M target by $29M and finished one year early.
Built and brought online a greenfield production data center outside the ERCOT grid in 18 months, self-funding the $52M investment and retiring a decade-old enterprise resilience risk.
Modernized the enterprise network from legacy Cisco to a unified Arista platform in 10 months and eliminated 90% of legacy infrastructure technology debt.
Tripled cloud capacity under managed FinOps, enabled 300+ cloud-native applications, and scaled generative-AI tools across engineering, infrastructure, and ServiceNow operations.
Presented quarterly to the USAA Board and USAA Bank Board and led recurring OCC and Federal Reserve reviews covering strategy, material risk, SDLC controls, resilience, and performance.

experience.title: Vice President – Enterprise IT Architecture
bullets: Served as enterprise technology strategist across P&C, banking, life, investment, and retirement businesses, leading 100+ technical architects and 10 senior technology fellows.
Guided the technology decision and cloud-first strategy for a $1.7B, seven-year Guidewire policy and claims modernization supporting an approximately $40B P&C business.
Advised and reviewed all strategic venture-capital investments for USAA's $300M investment fund, evaluating technology, architecture, integration, risk, scalability, and strategic fit.
Served as the IT lead overseeing USAA's acquisition of Noblr, directing technology diligence, integration strategy, architecture, risk, and execution readiness.
Selected Oracle Cloud ERP as the enterprise general-ledger platform and shaped the integration and modernization approach later delivered company-wide.
Established the SRE Center of Excellence and enterprise reliability patterns to strengthen production accountability, service health, and resilience.

experience.title: CIO, Property & Casualty (Interim)
bullets: Held accountability for a $700M P&C technology budget and 1,200+ resources during a leadership transition.

Built the business case and prepared business, product, engineering, and operations teams for the Guidewire transformation, reshaped talent and delivery capacity, and transitioned the portfolio to the permanent CIO.

experience.title: Assistant Vice President – P&C Systems
bullets: Held end-to-end accountability for customer-facing and production systems across the P&C division, aligning platform delivery with claims, underwriting, policy, billing, and member-service priorities.

experience.title: Assistant Vice President – Quality Assurance
bullets: Led 190 employees and 950+ partners on a $133M budget, providing centralized quality engineering and delivery assurance across an approximately $750M software portfolio.
Restructured the Testing Center of Excellence, generating $19M in annual efficiency gains and a $9M / 200-FTE reduction while improving quality and delivery assurance.

experience.title: Assistant Vice President – Distributed Systems & Systems Management
bullets: Led day-to-day operations for distributed systems, server environments, desktop support, and core operational tooling.
Managed 11 groups with 140+ employees and roughly $40M operating budget.

Increased data-center virtualization from 40% to 80%, expanded infrastructure capacity 350% at flat cost, and negotiated multimillion-dollar hardware and software deals that delivered more than $5M in savings in 2011.

experience.title: Assistant Vice President – Availability Assurance
bullets: Built USAA's Availability Command Center, a virtual NOC spanning the United States and India, in eight months.
Led a direct team of 50 and indirect team of 600 in support of 24x7x365 operations and 1.5M+ monthly batch jobs.
Reduced return-to-service time 25% year over year and eliminated on-call schedules while maintaining round-the-clock support.

experience.title: Director, Enterprise Infrastructure Architecture and Standards Management
bullets: Led worldwide enterprise infrastructure architecture and standards and helped guide Honeywell's global IT technology roadmap.
Developed architecture supporting consolidation of more than 500 data centers into two global facilities.
Helped reshape a $300M global telecommunications network and established TOGAF-based enterprise architecture consistency at executive level.

experience.title: Global Leader, Infrastructure Applications
bullets: Led global infrastructure application hosting, messaging, identity, and security operations for more than 100,000 users across 1,300+ facilities.
Delivered the largest Microsoft Exchange migration in company history, moving 22,000 users in three days.
Consolidated more than 400 resource domains and integrated 18 acquisitions in 12 months, generating multimillion-dollar annual savings.

experience.title: Director, Standards & Architecture
bullets: Served as principal technical authority for global infrastructure and IT security.
Designed and led a global infrastructure refresh with EUR 8M capital budget.
Deployed MPLS across 25+ countries, cutting annual telecommunications spend 25%, and drove data-center consolidation that reduced operating costs 35%.

experience.title: Consultant
bullets: Led infrastructure engineering on enterprise client engagements across North and South America.
Implemented ITIL-based service-delivery organizations, managed IT RFPs exceeding EUR 25M, and led system-engineering teams through complex transformation programs.

experience.title: Consultant
bullets: Led technical delivery on data-center, SLA, and infrastructure improvement engagements.
Delivered a data-center build-out that saved a client $1.5M annually and managed transition from IBM contract support to in-house operations.
